premises.text: Privacy regulation and internal privacy/legal/security processes make data access slow for AI and data teams
premises.evidence_span: It takes a long time to get access to data. Data is either locked away, or they have to go through a long process, including privacy engineering, legal, and security

premises.text: Private real data can be converted into 100% anonymized synthetic data with the same properties
premises.evidence_span: We convert private real data into 100% anonymized synthetic data that has the same properties as the real data

premises.text: Confidential computing lets computation run on encrypted data so BetterData cannot see the data
premises.evidence_span: We introduced confidential computing, where you can compute on encrypted data, so companies don't have to trust us with data because we can't even see it

premises.text: Data tokenization keeps ownership with the company via tamper-proof locks
premises.evidence_span: data tokenization. Companies own their data fully, and we have tamper-proof locks for that as well

premises.text: Encrypted multi-party collaboration can combine datasets and return shared synthetic data without revealing raw data
premises.evidence_span: safely collaborate with others, all while their customer data remains encrypted to all parties involved

premises.text: Licensing and support business with on-prem, private, and public cloud plus API or web interface
premises.evidence_span: We have a licensing and support business model, and we support on-premise, private, and public cloud

value.text: Companies innovate on data in days while protecting customer privacy
value.evidence_span: allows you to innovate on data in days and not months
